title: Pathavī
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahāpathaviyā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya || || 3. Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattikā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā saṅkham pi na upenti upanidham pi na upenti || pe || mahāpathavim upanidhāya sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā || || 4--5. Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || so yeva peyyālo || yogo karanīyo ti || ||
